answer: A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The vault counter is kept in wander and copper exposes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 315 aliases cost 233 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
